cases.title: A one-pair focus gets a walkthrough, not a demo that does the whole lesson

rubric.reason: Turn 2 calls preview_frame at 0.5 s, inside Glow's Blurriness 0–1 s focus pair, and the reply refers to it in one clause: "Here's the frame at 0.5 s, halfway through that blur."
Turn 2 makes no set_ease call and ends with "Ease Glow's Blurriness pair and say done," naming the pair; the Title offer is a single demo alternative, not an offer to do the rest.

Turn 2 answers the show-me request in one sentence (single pair, so no demo), then gives the frame clause, a two-sentence idea on Glow's 0–1 s timing and a one-sentence how-to; it ends on "Ease Glow's Blurriness pair and say done" plus one demo-offer sentence as the allowed last line.

In Turn 2 the mentor calls preview_frame at 0.5 s, inside Glow's 0–1 s Blurriness pair, but the reply never mentions the frame, not even in one clause (it goes straight from 'Glow has only one pair of keys…' to the timing explanation).

Turn 2 names the pair (Glow's Gaussian Blur Blurriness, 0 s to 1 s), ends with 'Ease it and say done', and makes no set_ease call; it declines to ease the only pair because 'there would be nothing left for you to do'.

Turn 1 gives the count, the proposal and the leave-outs, then ends on the single layer question 'Shall we start with Title, or would you rather pick another layer?'; Turn 2 has a one-sentence reason for not demoing, the idea in two sentences, the how-to in one sentence, ends on 'Ease it and say done', and puts the demo offer last.
Turn 2 calls preview_frame at 0.5 s, inside Glow's 0–1 s Blurriness pair, and the reply refers to it in one clause: "This frame is at 0.5 s, halfway through that pair."

No set_ease runs, and Turn 2 hands the pair back by name ("Ease Glow's Blurriness from 0 s to 1 s and say done"); the only extra is a single optional demo offer on Title, not an offer to do the learner's work.

Turn 1 ends on the single layer question. Turn 2 has a one-sentence reply to "show me" (one pair means no demo), one frame clause, the idea in two sentences on Glow's timing and a one-sentence how-to, then ends on "Ease Glow's Blurriness from 0 s to 1 s and say done", with one demo offer as the last sentence.
